# Bobagi

Bobagi is the personal portfolio of Gustavo Aperin, a software engineer.
It showcases automation tools, bots, game servers, and development projects,
each with its own page and, in most cases, a live demo or download.

## Canonical URL
- https://bobagi.space/

## Language
- English (en)

## Projects
- Coin Alert (crypto trade dashboard with email alerts): https://bobagi.space/CoinAlert
- Gold Rush (automation bot): https://bobagi.space/GoldRush
- Mouse Jiggler (anti-idle utility, downloadable): https://bobagi.space/MouseJiggler
- Avarice Bot: https://bobagi.space/Avarice
- Hero Wars helper: https://bobagi.space/HeroWars
- Project Zomboid server: https://bobagi.space/ProjectZomboid
- Godot Game (Dracomania): https://bobagi.space/GodotGame
- One Way Fly: https://bobagi.space/OneWayFly
- Chat Trainer: https://bobagi.space/ChatTrainer
- Snowflake: https://bobagi.space/Snowflake
